lines.zh: 我张开双翼，在浅海里缓缓滑过
lines.en: I spread my wings and glide through the shallows.

lines.zh: 我扇一下鳍，能滑出去十几米
lines.en: One flap carries me a dozen meters.

lines.zh: 宽大的翼尖掠过沙底，扬起一点尘
lines.en: My wingtip grazes the sand and lifts a little dust.

lines.zh: 我不急，这片海也不急
lines.en: I'm in no hurry, and neither is the sea.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，像一片会动的影
lines.en: I skim the surface like a moving shadow.

lines.zh: 暖流把我往前送，我顺着它
lines.en: The warm current pushes me, and I go with it.

lines.zh: 我转了个大弯，翅膀划出弧线
lines.en: I make a wide turn, wings carving an arc.

lines.zh: 海底的礁从我身下慢慢退后
lines.en: The reef slides slowly beneath me.

lines.zh: 我侧过一边的鳍，轻轻升起来
lines.en: I tilt one fin and rise gently.

lines.zh: 我游得很稳，水几乎不起浪
lines.en: I swim so steadily the water barely ripples.

lines.zh: 几只小鱼跟着我，蹭我的翼
lines.en: Small fish trail me, brushing my wings.

lines.zh: 我从沉船上方掠过，没碰它
lines.en: I pass over the wreck without touching it.

lines.zh: 我压低翼尖，贴着珊瑚走
lines.en: I lower a wingtip and coast past the coral.

lines.zh: 远处海面发亮，我朝那边去
lines.en: The surface gleams far off, and I head for it.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过浅水，在我背上散开。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the shallows and spreads over my back.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，白肚皮朝上。
lines.en: I roll over, pale belly to the light.

lines.zh: 我游过一片海草，鳍尖扫过它。
lines.en: I glide over seagrass and my fin tips brush it.

lines.zh: 有水泡从我嘴边升上去。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我悬在蓝水里，翅膀轻轻起伏
lines.en: I hover in the blue, wings rising and falling.

lines.zh: 我张口滤水，细小生物进了嘴
lines.en: I open my mouth to filter the tiny drifting life.

lines.zh: 沙底有一道我的影子，很大
lines.en: My shadow lies huge on the sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个身，什么也没追
lines.en: I turn slowly, chasing nothing.

lines.zh: 水从我的鳃里流出去，很安静
lines.en: Water passes through my gills, quietly.

lines.zh: 我在暖层里停住，懒得动
lines.en: I stop in the warm layer, too lazy to move.

lines.zh: 一条鱼躲在我翼下，我没管它
lines.en: A fish shelters under my wing; I let it.

lines.zh: 我看着头顶的光一圈圈晃
lines.en: I watch the light above sway in rings.

lines.zh: 我把翼收了一点，省点力气
lines.en: I fold my wings a little to save effort.

lines.zh: 这片海很宽，我不必赶路
lines.en: The sea is wide; I have nowhere to be.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，水都跟着动了
lines.en: I yawn, and the water moves with me.

lines.zh: 我轻轻扇了一下，只为了感觉
lines.en: I flap once, just to feel it.

lines.zh: 底下是沙，上面是光，中间是我
lines.en: Sand below, light above, and me between.

lines.zh: 我就这样漂着，等饿了再说
lines.en: I drift like this and wait until I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 你在我下面游，我绕着你转了半圈
lines.en: You swim below me; I circle you halfway.

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，凑近看你
lines.en: I lower my wings and come closer to look.

lines.zh: 你那么小，我一只眼就够看
lines.en: You're so small one eye is enough.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是有点好奇
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you, only curious.

lines.zh: 你吐的泡往上升，我一直看着
lines.en: Your bubbles rise, and I follow them up.

lines.zh: 我在你上方停住，影子盖住你
lines.en: I stop above you, and my shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 你伸出手，我没有躲开
lines.en: You reach out, and I don't pull away.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的船底滑过去
lines.en: I glide along the underside of your boat.

lines.zh: 你的灯在水里晃，我盯着那点光
lines.en: Your light sways underwater; I watch it.

lines.zh: 我转过头，让眼睛对着你
lines.en: I turn my head to put an eye on you.

lines.zh: 你的叉子扎进我的翼，很疼
lines.en: Your fork sinks into my wing, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我这么大，却躲不开这一下
lines.en: Big as I am, I couldn't dodge that.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，慢慢变淡
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and fades.

lines.zh: 我往下沉了一点，再稳住
lines.en: I sink a little, then steady myself.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我也会想跑
lines.en: Even I want to run when it hurts.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一歪，游得不太稳
lines.en: My wing tilts and I swim unevenly.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了你的船
lines.en: That blow taught me your boat.

lines.zh: 伤口不深，可我很不安
lines.en: The wound is shallow, but it unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我把受伤那边收起来，慢慢游
lines.en: I fold the hurt side and swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我该走了，这片水不再安全
lines.en: I should go; this water is no longer safe.

lines.zh: 那片浮游生物在发亮，我过去了
lines.en: That patch of plankton glows; I'm going.

lines.zh: 暖流拐了个弯，我跟着拐
lines.en: The warm current bends, and I bend with it.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑漂着，我张口接
lines.en: The crumbs you scatter drift, and I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 光在水里散开，我朝光源去
lines.en: Light spreads through the water; I head for it.

lines.zh: 有股味道很淡，但很好闻
lines.en: A faint smell, and a pleasant one.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，只是想看看那是什么
lines.en: I come closer, only to see what it is.

lines.zh: 你的船慢慢开，我就跟着
lines.en: Your boat moves slowly, so I follow.

lines.zh: 这片水浮着细小的东西，正好
lines.en: Tiny things float in this water, perfect.

lines.zh: 我停在你面前，等水流过来
lines.en: I stop before you and wait for the flow.

lines.zh: 我不是贪心，只是饿得刚好
lines.en: I'm not greedy; I'm just hungry enough.

lines.zh: 我的翼尖撞到你的腿，很轻
lines.en: My wingtip brushes your leg, very lightly.

lines.zh: 船底擦过我的背，我沉了一下
lines.en: The hull scrapes my back and I dip lower.

lines.zh: 我在礁石间转身，擦掉了一点皮
lines.en: I turn between rocks and scrape some skin.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞一堵软墙
lines.en: You bump into me like a soft wall.

lines.zh: 这里没有同伴，可礁石不少
lines.en: No companions here, but plenty of rocks.

lines.zh: 我收翼太慢，撞在沉船上
lines.en: I fold too slowly and hit the wreck.

lines.zh: 水一涌，我被推着撞上你
lines.en: The surge pushes me into you.

lines.zh: 这一下我翅膀发麻，缓了缓
lines.en: That numbs my wing; I ease off.

lines.zh: 我尽量绕开，可这水道太窄
lines.en: I try to go around, but the channel is narrow.

lines.zh: 碰到你之后，我往深处让了让
lines.en: After touching you, I give way into deeper water.

lines.zh: 这么大的海，我们居然碰上了
lines.en: In a sea this vast, we happened to meet.

lines.zh: 我们并排滑行，翼几乎叠在一起
lines.en: We glide abreast, wings nearly overlapping.

lines.zh: 它比我宽一点，我跟着它的节奏
lines.en: It's a bit wider than me; I match its rhythm.

lines.zh: 没有别的同类，只有这一回
lines.en: No other of our kind, just this once.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢转圈，水被搅出两道光
lines.en: We turn slowly, stirring two ribbons of light.

lines.zh: 它的翼尖碰到我，我没有避开
lines.en: Its wingtip touches mine, and I don't shy away.

lines.zh: 暖流正好，我们留在这层水里
lines.en: The current is right; we stay in this layer.

lines.zh: 我们都慢，谁也不催谁
lines.en: We're both slow, and neither hurries the other.

lines.zh: 这一刻海里安静得不像话
lines.en: For this moment the sea is impossibly quiet.

lines.zh: 它游远了，我也没追
lines.en: It swims away, and I don't follow.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我绕它转了一圈
lines.en: Something sinks; I circle it once.

lines.zh: 我张口接了一下，它太小了
lines.en: I open my mouth for it; it's too small.

lines.zh: 那根绳子挂在我翼尖上
lines.en: A rope catches on my wingtip.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我的嘴不干这个
lines.en: I don't pick things up; my mouth isn't built for it.

lines.zh: 漂着的木头我顶开了
lines.en: I nudge a floating log aside.

lines.zh: 它卡在我嘴里，我又吐出来
lines.en: It catches in my mouth, and I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我滤水的时候，顺带吞了些杂物
lines.en: While filtering, I swallow some junk by accident.

lines.zh: 这块东西比我见过的都亮
lines.en: This thing is brighter than anything I've seen.

lines.zh: 我用翼拨了拨，它就沉下去
lines.en: I flick it with a wing, and down it goes.

lines.zh: 别人的东西我不动
lines.en: I leave other creatures' things alone.

lines.zh: 有网从上方落下，我看见了
lines.en: A net drops from above, and I see it.

lines.zh: 水流被什么搅乱，我抬起头
lines.en: Something muddies the current; I look up.

lines.zh: 那根鱼线一直跟着我
lines.en: That fishing line keeps following me.

lines.zh: 水里的声响不对，我警觉了
lines.en: The sound in the water is wrong; I'm wary.

lines.zh: 我这么大，藏也藏不住
lines.en: I'm too big to hide.

lines.zh: 你手里那根秆，我不想碰
lines.en: That pole in your hand, I want no part of it.

lines.zh: 我加快了一点，可还是慢
lines.en: I speed up a little, but I'm still slow.

lines.zh: 它挡在我上面，我只好往下
lines.en: It blocks me from above, so I go down.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味，往旁边移开
lines.en: I smell blood and shift aside.

lines.zh: 这一片水域突然安静了
lines.en: This patch of water has gone quiet.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根线，翅膀都僵了
lines.en: I stare at the line, wings gone stiff.

lines.zh: 它还没动，我也不动
lines.en: It hasn't moved, and neither will I.

lines.zh: 我在算它离我有多远
lines.en: I'm measuring how far away it is.

lines.zh: 时间过得很慢，水也慢
lines.en: Time passes slowly, and so does the water.

lines.zh: 我想从它下面穿过去
lines.en: I think I'll slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 它一收线，我就该走了
lines.en: The moment it reels in, I should leave.

lines.zh: 我把翼收紧，准备转弯
lines.en: I tighten my wings, ready to turn.

lines.zh: 它在我侧后方，我感觉得到
lines.en: It's off my flank; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我还没决定，海替我决定
lines.en: I haven't decided; the sea decides for me.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，它就会动
lines.en: A little longer and it will move.

lines.zh: 我用翼扫了你一下，只是想推开
lines.en: I sweep a wing at you, only to push you off.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，然后立刻后悔
lines.en: I butt into you and regret it at once.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽了一下，没打中
lines.en: My tail whips out and finds only water.

lines.zh: 我撞你的船，船晃，我也晃
lines.en: I hit your boat; it rocks, and so do I.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，动起来很笨
lines.en: A body this big moves clumsily.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，可嘴里没有牙
lines.en: I open my mouth, but there are no teeth.

lines.zh: 我拍水，水花比伤更吓人
lines.en: I slap the water; the splash frightens more than it hurts.

lines.zh: 我撞完就退，不想再来一次
lines.en: I hit and recoil; I don't want a second try.

lines.zh: 我是被逼急了才动的手
lines.en: I only struck because I was cornered.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全力，还是很轻
lines.en: That was all my strength, and still gentle.

lines.zh: 我从深蓝里浮上来，翼还没展开
lines.en: I rise out of the deep blue, wings not yet spread.

lines.zh: 沙底很暖，我在这里成形
lines.en: The sand is warm; I take shape here.

lines.zh: 第一下扇翼，水纹荡了出去
lines.en: My first wingbeat sends ripples out.

lines.zh: 周围没有同类，我早已习惯
lines.en: No others of my kind; I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 光从上面落下来，照在我背上
lines.en: Light falls from above onto my back.

lines.zh: 我这么大，出现时水都动了
lines.en: I'm big enough that the water moves as I arrive.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升到浅层，找暖流
lines.en: I rise to the shallows, looking for the warm current.

lines.zh: 海底的沙被我扬起来一点
lines.en: I lift a little sand off the seafloor.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，先滤了一口水
lines.en: I open my mouth and take a first filter of water.

lines.zh: 这片海我认得，我留下了
lines.en: I know this sea, and I stay.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我拼命往下潜
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, and I dive hard.

lines.zh: 我摔回海里，震得全身发麻
lines.en: I crash back into the sea, numb all over.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的翼只能压在沙上
lines.en: Out of water, my wings just press the sand.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，水都白了
lines.en: The blast flips me, and the water goes white.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的背鳍，疼得发麻
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my back fin, numbing me.

lines.zh: 那股力裹住我，我动不了
lines.en: The force wraps me, and I can't move.

lines.zh: 水里太干净，我饿得发虚
lines.en: The water is too clear; hunger leaves me hollow.

lines.zh: 雷击穿海面，我全身一颤
lines.en: Lightning pierces the surface and shakes through me.

lines.zh: 海水没了，我朝黑里掉
lines.en: The water is gone, and I fall into the dark.
